name: Nikolay Veretennikov
summary: A Kazakh welterweight from Kings MMA (14-8, age 36), 2-3 in the UFC: he knocked out Niko Price (R1) in February, then was knocked out by Kalinn Williams (R1) in May.

how_they_fight.Defense: Stopped three times by knockout, two of them recent (Vanderford R2, Williams R1).
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Goes the distance with fellow strikers.

concerns: Age 36; knocked out twice in his last four
keys_to_beat: Pressure him and test his chin

news.text: Booked against Contender Series winner Ronald Humphrey.

sources.title: Contender Series standout books Octagon debut for UFC 335
